(ownership of voting rights 50.31%; receives financial support and management guidance), the group operates restaurants in formats such as yakiniku, sushi, izakaya, and everyday meals and fast food, through directly operated stores and franchised stores. It has eight consolidated subsidiaries and two affiliates, and as of March 31, 2026, the number of consolidated employees was 719. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.e181dc181e2b2783: For its existing formats, the plan is, on the premise of everyday use, to redesign products, prices and services as a whole centered on "mass appeal" and "casualness," and to advance strategic development as a volume-zone format with "mass-market dining out" as the keyword. In Japan, the plan is to expand its operating areas and business scale also using M&A, and overseas, to strengthen store openings centered on Asia through the franchise chain method and to expand into new areas such as the United States. It also aims to establish "next-generation stores" by strengthening the securing and development of human resources and rebuilding store operations through DX.
